run.name: Constellium SE
run.sector: Secondary Smelting & Refining of  Nonferrous Metals
run.title: CP-OS host session (CSTM)
run.summary: Constellium SE has a sound fundamental credit profile: net leverage fell to 1.56x with USD 992 million of liquidity and no senior notes due before 2028. Earnings quality and the 2029 refinancing, not near-term liquidity, decide the outcome. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context; the EDGAR registrant name in that context is CONSTELLIUM SE.

revenue.basis: Revenue, as the CP-1 table prints it.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. EBITDA is LTM Adjusted EBITDA excluding metal price lag, 1,354 less 289 = 1,065. Total debt is carrying value 1,817 at September 30, 2026; net debt is debt less cash 158 = 1,659 (company reports 1,658 after a cross-currency swap adjustment of 1). On Adjusted EBITDA as reported (1,354) the ratios are 1.34x and 1.23x. LTM mixes the FY2025 annual report with 2026 quarterly comparatives; the A&T segment revision affects earlier 2025 periods. Excludes 417 of receivables derecognized under factoring.

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. LTM Adjusted EBITDA excluding metal price lag 1,065 divided by LTM interest paid 100 (104 + 79 - 83). On Adjusted EBITDA as reported (1,354) the ratio is 13.54x. An LTM window is used so the figure covers twelve months of cash interest.

cash.basis: Cash. 541 ABL availability plus 114 French facility. Excludes factoring availability 179; company total liquidity 992. The October 22, 2026 ABL amendment (commitments 550 to 700) is a subsequent event and is not in these figures.

cashflow.basis: Cash from operations, as the CP-1 table prints it.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Covenant levels, indentures, guarantors, ownership and ratings are not in the sources, so creditor protection and distribution capacity are unassessed.
CP-1 main limitation: Covenant levels and agreements are not supplied; earnings include non-cash metal price lag and are management-adjusted.
